# Felipe Sotille

> Senior DevSecOps Architect & Coach. DevSecOps architect and coach for regulated, high-availability platforms (SWIFT, Swissquote). Designs the release-orchestration and security standards that squads ship through, then coaches 5+ squads until the standard holds: golden-path pipelines, SBOM, policy-as-code and DORA-aligned controls. Agent-first with Claude Code, Codex and Devin; a Java/Linux background means I speak the developers' language.

Freelance consultant based in Brussels, Italian (EU) citizen. Current role: DevSecOps Customer Success Architect at SWIFT (Jan 2025–Present).
Headline numbers: 17+ years in software engineering; 40+ Java apps on zero-touch release orchestration; 80%+ of the zero-touch deployment KPI, by my team; −40% patching time, 300+ VMs, 20+ pipelines.
